notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just want to let you guys know that we do pay attention to your comments both in here and over at our facebook fanpage. 

So we know that most of our players don't like the "Gotcha" traps in the game and the overrall amount of time you die playing, so we just made an update to make your experience more fun and less frustrating. 

Update Change log:
[list]

[*]All "Gotcha" traps have now a small marker so if you pay attention you can easily spot where a trap is.

[*]Fixed a recurrent bug with the first boss's attacks.

[*]Boss fights are easier now.
[/list]

As a bonus we will be running a sale this week offering a 70% off, so if you were in doubt to get the game because of the reviews talking about the difficulty, this is a good opportunity for you to give us a chance to show you we do care about our player base and we do want to deliver good, fun games.

Cheers!

notes.title: Red Goblin: Nightmare. Free! And other news!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just wanted to let you know that Red Goblin: Nightmare that will contain episode 2 on the series is on the works and will most likely be available to you on November.

Red Goblin: Nightmare was planned to be a DLC however we have decided that it will be available for free on a future update during November.

We are also working on our first JRPG in unity. If you want to support us here is our green-light link: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=476383755


Cheers!

notes.title: Red Goblin Challenge 2
notes.notes:
Hello Every one, Red Goblin First challenge has ended, congratulations to TaxOwlBear for winning our first contest, he will be added as an NPC in our upcoming update. Maybe you will win an achievement if you find him, no one knows!

Sadly no guides were posted so there is no winner for "The Expert" Title.

Now for our second challenge:

Price: "The Harlequin Title"
You will be added in the game a the "Harlequin" a mysterious creature that will give the player access to every ability in the game. (If the player can find you).

Of course you can brag about how you win the contest to be inside the game.

Bases:

All you have to do is write a review here in Steam, the review that have the more people finding it funny will be the winner!

The review must be in English.
The review doesn't need to be positive.
The winner will be picked in July 1st.

Good luck everyone!

notes.title: New Version Uploaded!
notes.notes:
Please be sure you are running version 1.19.

Changes:

[CHANGE] Removed extra input on input selection in launcher
[CHANGE] Added better controller support, added sensitivity
[CHANGE] By Default there is no joystick input set, so if you want to play using a controller please set your input in the launcher

[FIX] Some controller models not getting input from any key (Some d-pads are still not functional)

[CHANGE] Doubled the time text stay in the intro scene, so you have time to read the whole story

Thank you all for the reports and have a blast!

(Restarting Steam can trigger the download if you are not updated)

notes.title: Red Goblin Challenge (Win something)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we will start 2 challenges for you:

1.- The Legend.
-Make a Let's play video of Red Goblin. Video must show that you finished the game.

-For this one the first to post will be considered the winner and win the title of "The Legend"

What do you win? We will add you as an NPC (Custom made just for you) called whatever you like (No offensive names allowed) In the "programmers void" You will tell the player that you are the first one to beat the game and that you are because of that "The Legend".

2.- "The Expert"

-Post a guide for the game (On steam or Gamefaqs)

-For this one we will wait until June 1st.

-If more that 1 guide is posted we will pick the more complete guide as the winner.

What will you win? You will be added in the game to! under the nick name "The Expert" And of course you will brag about how you find Red Goblin so easy to complete!



Have a great one!!

notes.title: New Version Uploaded!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone be sure you have version 1.18 now since we added some features asked by the community.

[h1]Version Changes:[/h1]
[List]
[*][FIX] Fixed a small bug with the boss barrier switch delaying/getting wrong input

[*][FIX] Fixed A small graphical glitch with the water on some parts.

[*][CHANGE] Game over screen is gone, now you restart from save after dead

[*][CHANGE] Boss Difficulty lowered a little.

[*][CHANGE] Water is not lethal, only slows you down.
[/List]

We hope you like it!
Please be sure to share your comments/suggestions!
